title: row06
live_proof: inspection with a line number in the 3.22.0 tree: the nested-OR branch of fts3EvalNextRow at fts3.c:5134 keeps evaluating phrase nodes whose doclist was freed, because bEof was not set on the exhausted side. Fixed upstream in 3.32.0
object: the doclist of the exhausted side of a nested OR
lifetime_ender: the side is exhausted and its doclist freed, but bEof is not set, so evaluation continues through it
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator. Needs -DSQLITE_ENABLE_FTS3_PARENTHESIS, which is why this case has its own build group: without it the parentheses are ordinary characters, a flat query runs, and the case passes having tested nothing
